visual.name: bfusionCriticalChain
visual.description: Critical Chain (CCPM) diagnostic: resource-leveled longest path, Project & Feeding Buffers, Fever Chart monitoring, and optional portfolio ranking. Built on D3.js.

en-US.Visual_Short_Description: Critical Chain (CCPM) view with resource-leveled chain, buffers, and Fever Chart monitoring
en-US.Visual_Long_Description: BFUSION Critical Chain implements Goldratt's CCPM diagnostic: computes the resource-leveled longest path (Critical Chain), strips per-task safety into an aggregated Project Buffer and Feeding Buffers, and monitors buffer consumption via the Fever Chart. Includes inline mini-strip, full fever chart in the insight panel, optional resource swim-lane row layout, and optional portfolio mode ranking projects by fever color.

dataRoles.name: projectId
dataRoles.description: Project / plan identifier. When populated with more than one value, portfolio mode is activated.

dataRoles.name: taskId
dataRoles.description: Unique identifier for each task (WBS code or numeric ID).

dataRoles.name: duration
dataRoles.description: Task duration in days (assumed to already contain per-task safety).

dataRoles.name: resource
dataRoles.description: Primary resource / owner. Drives the resource-leveling step that separates Critical Chain from Critical Path.

dataRoles.name: startDate
dataRoles.description: Anchors the chain on a calendar (optional). When absent, day-numbered axis is used.

dataRoles.name: percentComplete
dataRoles.description: 0–100. Drives Fever Chart progress on the Critical Chain.

dataRoles.name: resourceDemand
dataRoles.description: Resource units consumed by the task while running (e.g. people, machines). Drives the stack height in the resource profile. Defaults to 1 when not bound.

dataRoles.name: statusDate
dataRoles.description: Optional 'today' reference for buffer-consumption / fever chart. When unbound, the visual uses the current date relative to min(Start Date).

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model.

feedingBufferPct.displayName: Feeding Buffer (% of stripped feeding chain)

showCPProfile.displayName: Show top profile (CP schedule, resource conflict)

showTaskLabels.displayName: Show task numbers on stack blocks

portfolioMode.displayName: Portfolio mode (when Project ID is populated)

useDateAxis.displayName: Use calendar date axis (when Start Date provided)

timeUnit.displayName: Time unit label (e.g. days, weeks, hours)

demandUnit.displayName: Demand unit label (e.g. units, FTE, hours)
